changelog:
blog-image-enricher 1.0.1

- SKILL.md updated to remove references to web citations and streamline text.
- Skill instructions and behavior unchanged; only removed inline references like [web:2] and [web:6].
- File skill-card.md removed to simplify distribution.
summary: Read a plain Markdown file (e.g. 260321_openclawConfig.md), generate header and section images using the default OpenClaw image model and API key from ~/openclaw/.env, create a new *_img.md copy with embedded PNGs, and move all generated images into an img/ folder next to the original file.
